capabilities: Display notes as resizable cards sized by content amount
Highlight the active pane and gray out inactive ones
Toggle card view on or off with a command
Customize card colors, corner radius, drop shadow and background
disambiguation: Not a Kanban or task board; it only changes how notes are displayed as cards, not how their content is organized.
extras: Compatibility with the Banners plugin is stated to be not yet stable. The README references a demo, but no usage examples beyond settings descriptions are included.
motivation: The author found that notes are at different stages of development and wanted a way to weigh them, since assessing atomicity helps decide when to divide or extract content.
problem: Obsidian's default note view shows every note uniformly, so it is hard to see at a glance how developed or atomic each note is.

relations.evidence: This plugin is inspired by Scrapbox (a web-based wiki tool) & Zettelkasten method
I highly recommend you to use this plugin with the Sliding Pane plugin.
I made this to be compatible with that and the Embedded Note Titles plugin.

summary: Renders notes as Scrapbox-style cards whose height reflects content amount, and highlights the active pane via an attention pane.
